title: States, Discoveries and Refusals in Testimony
goal: Distinguish ongoing historical states from archival discoveries, first encounters, refusals and failed attempts.
grammar: Aspectual shifts of saber, conocer, querer and poder in the past

items: I can contrast standing knowledge (*sabía*, *conocía*) with archival discoveries and first encounters (*supo*, *conoció*).
I can distinguish deliberate institutional refusal (*no quiso*) from failed attempts (*no pudo*) in historical accounts.
I can report oral-history and archival research accurately using *manuscrito*, *hemeroteca* and *genealogía*.
